verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has documented first-class concurrency limits, queues, and concurrency keys for per-user/per-resource throttling (docs-6, docs-37), plus built-in retrying with exponential backoff to handle rate-limit errors gracefully (docs-5, docs-28), and dedicated queue-and-concurrency product docs describing bespoke queue logic for respecting downstream limits. Community feedback corroborates queue/concurrency features working well in production. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party example wiring a queue specifically to a third-party API's rate limit, and no independent benchmark of throttling behavior under load.
